features.title: Real screenshots. Zero fluff.
features.subtitle: Every highlight below frames the exact region inside real captures of Audify — click any chapter to glide the spotlight across the interface.

items.title: Zero-Latency Deck & Slicing
items.shortDesc: Sub-millisecond transport, live semitone pitch shift, and non-destructive right-drag waveform slicing.
items.detail: Audition thousands of files instantaneously with keyboard scrubbing, live -12st to +12st pitch preview, and right-drag slice markers (I / O). Dragging a slice into your NLE exports a clean cropped WAV without ever touching the original file.

items.title: Instant FTS5 Search & Waveforms
items.shortDesc: Filter 50,000+ samples at 60fps with virtualized mini waveforms and quick tag chips.
items.detail: Powered by SQLite FTS5 + WAL in Rust. Search across file names, folders, genres, BPM, keys, and custom tags while virtualized 34px rows stream precomputed waveform envelopes with zero UI stutter.

items.title: Offline AI Acoustic Similarity
items.shortDesc: Drop any audio clip onto the window to rank acoustically similar hits in 0.2 ms — 100% locally.
items.detail: Audify runs an optional local YAMNet ONNX embedding model right on your CPU with zero cloud calls. Drop an external reference sound or trigger similarity from any row to surface matching impacts, swooshes, or textures in fractions of a millisecond.

items.title: Faceted Tags & Genre Taxonomy
items.shortDesc: Organize SFX and music with color-coded facets, rule-based auto-tagging, and instant filter drawers.
items.detail: Keep massive libraries tidy with structured tag facets (Action & Combat, Voice & Music, Nature & Ambience) and Genre/Mood drawers. Every color swatch follows a unified studio palette across Dark, Light, and Contrast themes.

items.title: Mini Dock & Edge-Peek Companion
items.shortDesc: Collapse Audify into a compact always-on-top dock (Ctrl+M) or let it rest silently at the edge of your monitor.
items.detail: Built for single- and dual-monitor editors alike. Use Mini Dock standalone over DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro, or enable the optional Win32 Edge-Peek strip so it rests unobtrusively at your screen edge and expands on hover.

items.title: WASAPI Audio & Deep Control
items.shortDesc: Output device routing, normalization, loudness targets, custom themes, and Protected Vault safety.
items.detail: Choose your exact Windows audio output device, configure LUFS loudness normalization, sync multi-window themes seamlessly, and enable Protected Vault locks so your master archive can never be renamed or deleted by mistake.

workflow.title: Drop one .exe anywhere. Take your entire studio with you.
workflow.subtitle: Audify requires zero installers and writes zero Windows Registry entries. Put Audify.exe on an internal SSD or external NVMe drive — your index, peaks, tags, and settings live cleanly inside ./user/ right beside it.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, honest answers before you download.

leftColumn.q: Does Audify require installation or write to the Windows Registry?
leftColumn.a: No. Audify is a portable single executable. Drop Audify.exe into any folder and it stores its SQLite database, waveform cache, and settings inside ./user/ right beside the binary. Uninstall is simply deleting the folder.

leftColumn.q: Does the AI tagger or similarity search send audio to the cloud?
leftColumn.a: Never. Audify enforces an offline-first architecture with zero telemetry. The optional YAMNet ONNX model executes 100% locally on your CPU, and external audio drops are analyzed strictly on your machine.

leftColumn.q: Can Audify accidentally delete or rename my master sample library?
leftColumn.a: Enable Protected Vault on any library root to make it strictly read-only inside Audify. Even on writable roots, deletions require two-step confirmation, route to quarantine/Recycle Bin, and support atomic undo.

leftColumn.q: How much RAM does Audify use on 50,000+ sample libraries?
leftColumn.a: Because Audify pairs a Rust/SQLite WAL backend with virtualized table rendering and compact peak envelopes, typical memory usage stays lean — far below Electron-based browsers.

rightColumn.q: Why might Windows SmartScreen appear on first launch?
rightColumn.a: Independent portable Windows builds without a costly EV code-signing certificate can trigger a first-run SmartScreen prompt. Click 'More info → Run anyway' and verify the SHA-256 checksum published on the release page.

rightColumn.q: What happens if my external sample drive changes drive letters?
rightColumn.a: Audify includes smart root relinking and portable path handling so if your NVMe drive shifts from D: to E:, you can relink the root in one step without losing tags, favorites, or waveform caches.

rightColumn.q: Which audio formats and NLE/DAW apps are supported?
rightColumn.a: Audify natively decodes WAV (including Broadcast WAV metadata), FLAC, MP3, OGG, AIFF, and M4A/AAC, and uses native Windows OLE drag-and-drop compatible with DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Ableton Live, FL Studio, and REAPER.

rightColumn.q: Is a macOS or Linux build available?
rightColumn.a: Audify is currently engineered specifically for Windows 10/11 (leveraging native Win32 Edge-Peek and WASAPI). Cross-platform builds may be explored after the Windows feature roadmap matures.
